{{Quote|Grrarrcckk!|One of the creatures|<ref name="Legacy (2013) 7">[[Legacy (2013) 7|''Legacy'' (2013) 7]]</ref>}}
A quadripedal '''species of creature''' with [[Color/Legends|purple]] skin, a hunched back, plenty of sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]], and at least one tusk existed in the galaxy. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[138 ABY]], one of them was [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iego/Legends|Iego]] by the delivery crew of [[AG-37]] and [[Sauk]], aboard [[AG-37's freighter]].
